g.text: 793 m of wall. no way in
1 — 793 m of exterior wall with not one opening in it, which `arch lint` reports as
W_NO_ENTRANCE: both teams start the round already inside. 2 — Mid, Long and B Doors are the only
doors; the other 18 thresholds are cased openings. 3 — a stacked crate is two crates in one
place on a horizontal cut, and the machine fix would delete the boost. Zones: T 2,044 m² · A
1,268 · B 1,040 · mid 708 · CT 696. `arch suggest` offers to fit the map with a front door.
